scope: Local vendor/provider reference evidence; not proof that the experimental restricted GPU transport is qualified

observations.fact: Successful CSTATE emission does not ring; following IDC PUT is appended. Error paths ring to prevent deferred-submission deadlock.
Fetching-AMO delivery flush builds a zero-initialized DMA PUT with flush=1 and leaves request_len at zero, then appends it after the AMO. This is a distinct path from our restricted marker.
FI_MORE defers publication to a later operation; delivery completion uses a target PCIe flushing read.
Vendor send benchmark explicitly emits a zero-length DMA PUT.
